remarks: Discover the timeless elegance of this stunning colonial-style home, a perfect blend of classic charm and modern comfort. Nestled in a serene neighborhood, this residence offers an expansive layout with the perfect amount of living space. Step inside to find a grand foyer leading to well-appointed living spaces and a kitchen with endless potential with the open concept providing plenty of room for entertainment. The kitchen seamlessly flows into the cozy family room, where a charming fireplace invites you to relax and unwind as well as large windows and sky lights let in an abundance of warm natural light. The upper-level features 5 large bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms with one half bath on the main level. Don't forget about the large two car garage to keep your precious cars out of the elements! Schedule you're viewing today. Bring forward all offers!
